title: The Natural History of Wiltshire
author: John Aubrey
description: "The Natural History of Wiltshire" by John Aubrey is a historical account written during the late 17th century.
longDescription: This work reflects Aubrey's compilation of observations, folklore, and scientific insights about the natural and cultural aspects of Wiltshire, making it a valuable resource for anyone interested in regional history and topography.

authorInfo.bio: John Aubrey (1626–1697) wrote The Natural History of Wiltshire. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
authorInfo.edition: Complete historical source edition, with original credits and licence retained.

rights: Source edition: public domain in the United States. Listed creative contributors screened for India, UK and EU; original licence retained.

rightsReview.policy: US public-domain source; all listed creative contributors died by 1900. Unknown dates excluded. Edition screening, not legal certification.
